models_evaluated: deep-learning CDSS for gastric carcinogenesis (6-class lesion classification, atrophy/IM segmentation, lesion detection)

links.outcome: Overall accuracy of CDSS versus experienced endoscopists on prospective real-clinic evaluation
links.effect: No significant difference in overall accuracy between invited endoscopists and established CDSS in prospective real-clinic evaluation (P=.23).
links.quote: There was no significant difference in the overall accuracy between the invited endoscopists and established CDSS in the prospective real-clinic evaluation (P=.23).

links.outcome: Classification accuracy on internal test versus external test from another institution
links.effect: Overall accuracy 90.3% (89%-91.6%) internal; 85.3% (83.4%-97.2%) on external test of 1282 images from another institution.
links.quote: For the performance validation, the CDSS achieved 85.3% (83.4%-97.2%) overall accuracy.

screen.reason: The study validates a deep-learning CDSS for endoscopy in external tests and prospective real-world screening procedures, but focuses on diagnostic performance without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
